prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT the supplied animation sheet. This is an atlas spacing and registration correction ONLY. Preserve ALL six existing individual poses exactly, the same character, camera, clothing, weapon, weapon hand, lighting and pose order. Preserve strict vertical 90-degree overhead view. Output exactly 1536x1024 RGBA PNG, exact 3x2 grid of six 512x512 cells. The current sheet spills over cell edges, especially extended arms/clubs. Make EACH whole actor and his entire club SMALLER inside its cell by about 25 percent and translate as needed so ALL visible artwork stays at least 40 pixels away from ALL FOUR edges of its own cell, including extreme weapon poses and fallen limbs. NOTHING may cross x=512, x=1024 or y=512 boundaries. The six whole actors must be isolated. Same character body scale across all six poses; cap crown about 90 pixels wide in upright frames, do not change anatomy by squeezing. Register upright cap crown approximately at (256,240) within its cell; for the death collapse use a consistent ground/root point at (256,256), preserving the authored fall progression. No per-frame stretching, no changing poses, no adding bodies. Everything except actor and club must be fully alpha-zero: no ground, cast shadow, colored background, glow, haze, vignette, text, visible grid, checkerboard painting or labels. Six poses unchanged, generous transparent gutters, true transparent background.
